invariants.currency: R; R_to_C=1; no RUB redemption right
invariants.eligibility: Open objective role/task allocation including HR/managers, no admission list; all7200 financed. One person/source group/cycle, comparable strata <=100 split before effort.

lower_tier.qualification: Current normalized Q>=1; exposure and rubric QA pass; no quota, no personal improvement condition.

contests.groups: Design nominal180 comparable groups40, inside department; size1..100; sum unique eligible<=7200.
contests.ranking: Current Q>=1.10, rank floor(100*Q+0.5)/100 descending; lower uses unrounded Q>=1.00. Individual/team mode fixed before effort.
contests.team_rule: Same full group pool250*n; teams occupy first/second slots8000/2000 at n40, NOT250*n_team cap. One team sum split by predeclared independent FTE shares; absent/unqualified members share unissued, not moved to others. All group/team/person awards together <=pool.
contests.tie_rule: A tie occupying ranks r..r+k-1 shares sum of prize slots at those ranks equally across all tied units, including beyond rank2. Then FTE division; floor final personal R; residual stays unissued. No lexical tie-break money.
contests.small_groups: Only1 registered competing eligible unit BEFORE results =>top0. Two+ registered units use both slots even if only1 qualifies (then first slot80% paid, second unissued). Fewer qualifying units leaves unoccupied slot unissued. Teams not split artificially to invent an opponent.
contests.cross_department: One benefitID, one owning department/source group; participating persons counted once in that group budget and cannot enter another ordinary group same cycle; shares sum<=1. No duplicate department award.

special.approval: Independent benefit owner verifies; separate nonrecipient HR posts; HR/manager own benefit outside their reporting/control chain, named alternate. No recipient selects amount or exception.
special.allocation: Within each prequalified level, timestamp of independent ready confirmation; exact timestamp tie shares occupied fixed slots of that level. Personal cap checked before assignment; next eligible record fills empty slot. No promise for every nomination; assigned awards are irrevocable rights.

stacking.special_plus_regular: Only different benefitID or evidenced incremental benefit excluded from ordinary metric; no duplicate same benefit.
stacking.cap_formula: 4*500+4*20000+2*7500=97000; n<=100 makes top cap nonbinding. One lower/ordinary group/person/cycle; no cap savings used for funding.

invariant_checks: lower/top80-20/special every personal amount and dates unchanged
